competitors.title: How to Fix Next.js AI Route Failures (Without Restarting from Zero)
key_points: Next.js route handlers have no memory — each failure restarts the entire pipeline from zero
Multi-step AI pipelines compound costs: 5 steps at 99% reliability = 95% overall, 10 steps = 90%
Step-level durability via Inngest Durable Endpoints: each step is independently retryable and memoized
Migration requires 4 changes: install Inngest + endpointAdapter, swap POST for inngest.endpoint(), wrap external calls in step.run(), add durableFetch on client
Durable Endpoints vs Durable Functions: Endpoints for user-waiting work, Functions for background work
Current limitations: no POST body support, no flow control, no streaming for Endpoints
Parallel LLM calls with Promise.all() work naturally — each step is independently durable

competitors.title: How to Build a Durable AI Agent with Inngest
key_points: Three primitives: step.run() (durable unit of work), step.invoke() (sync sub-agent delegation), step.sendEvent() (fire-and-forget async)
Agent loop is a while loop wrapped in step.run() — each LLM call and tool execution is a durable step
Singleton concurrency: one run per session at a time, cancel on new message
Sub-agents via step.invoke() — parent pauses (no compute burned), child runs with own context and tools
Extended traces middleware provides full step-level observability via OpenTelemetry
Context pruning: old tool results get soft-trimmed or hard-cleared; compaction summarizes session history
Budget warnings and overflow recovery prevent context-too-large errors mid-run

competitors.title: Your Agent Needs a Harness, Not a Framework
key_points: Utah (Universally Triggered Agent Harness) — event-driven agent harness built on Inngest steps and events
Six functions communicating through events, not one monolith: message handler, typing indicator, reply, failure handler, etc.
Sub-agents fork session context into own sub-session with focused task and outcome
Singleton concurrency keyed on sessionKey — only one agent run per chat at a time
Context management is the real challenge: two-tier pruning (within-run) + compaction (across-run)
Multi-provider LLM support via pi-ai abstraction (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google)

Orchestration-native observability: 40% diagnose in minutes vs 29% on APM tools, 11x gap on worst-case outcomes

competitors.title: Introducing Durable Endpoints: Durability beyond workflows
key_points: Durable Endpoints bring step-level durability to API handlers — no queues, no workers, no infrastructure
Steps checkpoint as they complete; failures retry from last successful step, not from scratch
Built-in observability: see exactly what's running, what failed, and why — no instrumentation required
Low latency by design, powered by Checkpointing for fast execution
Beyond AI: payment processing, webhook handlers, third-party integrations, e-commerce transactions
Available in public beta — add endpointAdapter to Inngest client, wrap handler with inngest.endpoint()
